rows.label: tlk45320153_01_msg0002
rows.name:
This is a great place to take in the
whole right shoulder of Superbia's
Divine Beast.

rows.label: tlk45320153_01_msg0003
rows.name:
When monsters approach, we drive them
off with the cannons in the Second
Wing, Shemesh, which you came through.

rows.label: tlk45320153_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Senpai and I keep watch every day to
make sure nothing seems amiss.

rows.label: tlk45320153_01_msg0005
rows.name:
By the way, Senpai's slacking off...
so I always keep watch alone...
